# /etc/systemd/system/davinci-assets-refresh.timer
[Unit]
Description=DaVinci assets refresh, native rate-limited
After=network-online.target

[Timer]
OnBootSec=3min
OnUnitActiveSec=30min
AccuracySec=2min
Unit=davinci-assets-refresh.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

# /etc/systemd/system/davinci-assets-refresh.timer
[Unit]
Description=DaVinci assets refresh, native rate-limited
After=network-online.target

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 06:15:00
AccuracySec=5min
Persistent=true
Unit=davinci-assets-refresh.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
existing_pre_job: both davinci-render-node and davinci-agent-node ExecStartPre davinci-render-preflight.sh calls assets-refresh.sh --prestart
limitation: Preflight guaranteed at render-node start, not certified for multiple queue jobs within same running process
